tokens.name: brand-100

tokens.name: brand-300
tokens.usage: Brand graphics only (chart series, illustrations). Never text.

tokens.name: brand-500
tokens.usage: THE brand orange. Primary button fill, active-item icons, progress bars, highlighted chart bar, menu highlight. Text on it is `on-brand` (dark) – white on brand-500 fails contrast (2.9:1).

tokens.name: brand-700
tokens.usage: Brand as text on white: links, text buttons, eyebrow labels (5.6:1 on surface).

tokens.name: brand-900
tokens.usage: Deep brand for text on brand-100.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background of the web app and iOS grouped screens.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, lists, tables, inputs. Sits on `bg`.

tokens.name: sidebar-bg
tokens.usage: Web sidebar (flat, edge-to-edge, `separator` on its right).

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Secondary button, meter/progress track, selected table row, S icon button inside fields.

tokens.name: fill-strong
tokens.usage: Active sidebar item, segmented-control track in flat contexts.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows, sidebar edge, toolbar bottom edge.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Input and outlined-button borders; flat overlay borders.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `bg`, `surface`, `fill`, `glass-bg`.

tokens.name: label-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text (labels, metadata, column heads) on `surface` and `bg` (≥4.5:1).

tokens.name: label-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled text only – not for readable content.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `brand-500` fills (primary buttons, menu highlight).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and text buttons on `surface` and `bg`.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Positive deltas („+3 ggü. Vormonat“) on `surface`.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Negative deltas, errors, destructive menu items on `surface` and `glass-bg`.

tokens.name: segment-selected
tokens.usage: Selected segment of a flat segmented control (text `label`, dark: white). FLAT: no shadow, no border, no gradient.

tokens.name: tab-selected
tokens.usage: Selected tab inside the glass tab switcher (TabSwitcher), with `tab-highlight` inset. Never used in a segmented control.

tokens.name: tab-highlight
tokens.usage: inset 0 1px 0 specular edge on the selected glass tab.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring on every focusable control (≥3:1 on all surfaces; brand-500 itself is too light on white).

tokens.name: glass-bg
tokens.usage: Liquid Glass fill for context menus, notifications/alerts, toasts, popovers, dialogs (+ mobile controls). Always with backdrop blur `glass-blur`.

tokens.name: glass-border
tokens.usage: Darkened outer edge of glass elements (macOS 27 look).

tokens.name: glass-highlight
tokens.usage: Inner specular edge of glass elements (inset 1px).

tokens.name: toolbar-bg
tokens.usage: Uniform frosted toolbar band across the content area (blur `toolbar-blur`), `separator` underneath.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: Page title on iOS and component pages.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Section headings, KPI numbers (32px variant allowed).

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Page title inside the web toolbar.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Card titles, list titles, notification titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Der Standard für Fließtext und Listen.
styles.usage: Body copy, iOS list rows (16px there).

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Web default for tables, sidebar items, buttons, inputs.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Help text, metadata, menu items, segmented labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Column heads, field labels, tags, section headers in the sidebar.

spacing.note: Component-internal steps are xs–xl (6–14px); layout uses 2xl+ (16–64px).

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in chips and status dots.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a group, icon-to-label in buttons.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Sidebar item gap, menu item padding.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding, toolbar gaps.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Search-field padding, list-row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: Gap between cards, card padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-3xl
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, mobile screen gutter.

tokens.name: space-4xl
tokens.usage: Web content gutter, gap between sections in cards.

tokens.name: space-5xl
tokens.usage: Large section spacing.

tokens.name: space-6xl
tokens.usage: Page padding of documentation pages.

radius.note: Desktop: medium controls use radius-md; XL controls, search fields and chips are pill. Mobile: controls are pill from the start; cards use radius-xl.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags, checkboxes, chart bar tops (6px top, 0 bottom).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: S buttons, icon buttons inside fields, menu items, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Desktop M/L buttons, inputs, selects, segmented tracks (flat).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: macOS cards, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Web and iOS cards, notifications, sidebar-free panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: XL buttons, search fields (always), chips, toolbar groups, segmented controls in toolbars, all mobile controls, toasts.

shadow.note: Flat surfaces carry no shadow. Only glass elements get depth. Segmented controls are flat: the selected segment has NO shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Context menus, notifications, toasts, popovers (with glass-bg + glass-border).

tokens.name: shadow-tabs
tokens.usage: Track of the glass TabSwitcher (with glass-bg, glass-border, glass-blur).

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Everything flat: cards, buttons (buttons never glow), sidebar, tables, segmented controls (track AND selected segment).

blur.note: Backdrop-filter radii for glass. Pair with saturate(180%).

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter: blur(glass-blur) saturate(180%) on glass overlays.

tokens.name: toolbar-blur
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter for the frosted toolbar band.

opacity.note: Glass opacity is 55%; with prefers-reduced-transparency fall back to the flat variant (solid surface + border).

tokens.name: glass-opacity
tokens.usage: Alpha of glass-bg in both themes.

tokens.name: track-tint
tokens.usage: Alpha of brand-500 for non-highlighted chart bars (dark: 0.32).
